offering_description.value: Helen of Troy sells beauty, wellness, household and outdoor products to retailers and consumers. It develops products under owned and licensed brands, uses third-party manufacturers, and sells through retail partners and its own websites.

primary_products.value: hair styling tools and hair care products; thermometers and air treatment appliances; kitchen and household tools; insulated drinkware; outdoor and travel packs

customer_segment.value: B2B: Mass merchants, pharmacies, beauty and outdoor specialty retailers, and online retailers; B2C: Consumers buying personal care, home wellness, kitchen and outdoor products

end_markets.value: beauty and personal care; home health and wellness; housewares; outdoor recreation; travel

revenue_model.value: product sales: Wholesale and direct consumer purchases of beauty, wellness, household and outdoor products

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: Develops products, sources finished goods from contract manufacturers, and sells to retailers and consumers

geography_served.value: global: United States and Canada, with sales in Europe, Asia-Pacific and other international markets

specialization.value: related lines: Beauty tools and hair care, home wellness devices, kitchen tools, drinkware and outdoor packs

distribution_channels.value: third-party retail: Mass merchants, pharmacy chains, and beauty, housewares and outdoor specialty stores; online: Company-operated brand websites, online marketplaces and retailer websites

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Consumer product and electrical safety rules, cosmetics requirements, and FDA medical device rules for products such as thermometers

notes: Recent portfolio changes and the current relative size of the product lines are uncertain.
